sections.heading: Frequently Asked Questions About Getting Started

items.q: Is the first consultation really free?
items.a: Yes — completely. There's no obligation to work with us after the call, and we won't treat it as an excuse to pitch you services regardless of whether they're relevant to your situation.

items.q: What should I prepare before the consultation?
items.a: Nothing formal is required. It helps to have a rough sense of your business goals and current marketing situation (what you're doing now, what's working, what isn't), but we'll guide the conversation if you're not sure where to start.

items.q: How quickly can you start if we decide to work together?
items.a: Onboarding timelines vary by service, but most clients can begin within 1–2 weeks of signing, depending on information-gathering and any setup requirements.
